common.blankMeaning: A dash (—) means a blank, not-yet-entered value. It is not 0.
common.traceHint: Each value carries its report field ID and the saved record it comes from.
common.name: Name

validation.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount in MAD, for example 603 or 603.50.
validation.invalidDate: That date is not valid. The default date is shown instead.

home.title: Branch operations

prototypes.dailyClose: A month of closed days with sales, orders, average order value, card and remittance ratios.
prototypes.cashCount: A saved cash count, its reconciliation at count time, and a later bank deposit.
prototypes.comparison: One shared date pair for Maarif, Al Quds and Bourgogne, with missing figures marked.

shortcuts.title: Quick access
shortcuts.reports: Review report fields and their sources.
shortcuts.inventory: Record or review adjustments for Maarif.
shortcuts.audit: Review changes and who made them.
shortcuts.catalog: Items, Foodics names, units and recipe versions.

home.modulesIntro: The structure is in place; each area is built in the phase shown.

closing.name: Daily closing
closing.description: Business days, payments, expenses, remittances, cash counts

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.description: Product Mix, stock movements, counts, variance

home.noAccess: Your account has no permissions yet. Ask Abdo to assign a permission group.

dailyClose.title: Daily close
dailyClose.intro: One row per business day. A day that is not closed shows its date and blank figures.
dailyClose.totalsNote: {days} closed days included. The average is total sales divided by total orders.
dailyClose.ordersMissingNote: {days} closed days have no order count, so the average may be overstated.
dailyClose.dayNotClosed: This day is not closed. No figures are shown.
dailyClose.dayNoRecord: No business day was recorded for this date.

cashCount.title: Cash count
cashCount.intro: Expected cash is the cash expected at the moment of the count. A deposit made later does not change the count result.
cashCount.dayNotClosed: This day is not closed, so there is no count to show.
cashCount.dayNoRecord: No business day was recorded for this date.
cashCount.recalcOk: Recalculating at count time gives the same stored result.
cashCount.recalcDiffers: Recalculation differs from the stored result.
cashCount.noCount: No cash count was saved for this day. It is not counted, and no match is shown.

status.match: Match: the count equals the expected cash.
status.cannot_reconcile: Counted, but the expected cash cannot be calculated because opening cash, sales or card is blank.

cashCount.afterCountNote: These movements happened after the count. They change the cash in the drawer, not the count result.
cashCount.drawerAfter: Cash in the drawer after later movements
cashCount.expectedAtClose: Expected cash after all movements of the day
cashCount.previewHelp: Type a counted amount to see the result as at {time}. Leave it empty for “not counted”. 0 is a real count of zero.
cashCount.pendingBody: Who counted the cash and who was the cashier are not recorded yet. The role rules are decided in Phase 4.

comparison.title: Branch comparison
comparison.intro: One date pair is used for every branch. A branch with no figure is marked missing, never shown as 0.

ratioReason.prior_missing_or_zero: No ratio: the prior figure is missing or zero.
ratioReason.different_branches: No ratio: the two totals cover different branches.

comparison.reportingOnlyNote: Al Quds and Bourgogne figures are entered for reporting only. Maarif comes from its closed days.

reportMap.title: Report map
reportMap.intro: Every report field with its legacy cell, source record, unit, date basis, rounding, blank behavior and any open decision. Source: the reviewed Phase 1 field map.
reportMap.summary: {total} fields: {settled} agreed, {pending} waiting for a later-phase decision.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the email and password Abdo gave you.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, we send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and open the link on this device.

password.title: Choose a new password
password.introRequired: Your password was set by an administrator. Choose your own password to continue.
password.introRecovery: Choose a new password for your account.
password.intro: Choose a new password for your account.

notices.session_ended: Your session ended because your account is not active. Ask Abdo if this is a mistake.

errors.invalid: The email or password is not correct.
errors.not_allowed: This account cannot sign in. Ask Abdo to check that it is active.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.link_invalid: This reset link is not valid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.email_in_use: That email is already used by another account.
errors.employee_number_in_use: That employee number is already used.
errors.weak_password: The password must be at least 10 characters and not too easy to guess.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.same_password: Choose a password different from the current one.
errors.last_admin: The organization must keep at least one active System Admin.
errors.self_disable: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.not_found: That staff account was not found.
errors.invalid_access: That branch and group combination is not allowed.
errors.unavailable: The service did not answer. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed. Try again.
errors.catalog_stale: Someone else changed this record. Reload the page and try again.
errors.catalog_duplicate: That name, code or Foodics name is already in use.
errors.catalog_overlap: Those dates overlap another approved recipe version of the same product.
errors.catalog_date_unconfirmed: The effective date of this recipe set is not confirmed yet, or the dates do not follow it.
errors.catalog_incomplete: A recipe line is incomplete: every line needs an ingredient, a quantity and a unit.
errors.catalog_unit: A recipe line uses a unit that does not convert to its ingredient's base unit. Fix the unit or add the approved conversion.

notices.created: The account was created. Give the temporary password to the person privately.
notices.disabled: The account is disabled. The person is signed out and cannot sign in.
notices.password_reset: The temporary password was set. The person must choose their own at the next sign-in.
notices.catalog_date_answered: The date was recorded. The linked recipe versions can now be approved on it.
notices.catalog_names_queued: The names were added to the review queue.

warnings.auth_not_updated: The change was saved, but the sign-in service did not confirm it. Every request from this person is already refused; try the same action again to finish.

access.organizationHelp: Applies to every branch and does not need a branch.
access.branchHelpOperational: Groups here work on the daily operation of this branch.
access.branchHelpComparison: Figures of this branch are for comparison only. Only comparison permissions apply here.

system_admin.name: System Admin
system_admin.description: Manages users, configuration, recipes, approvals, reports and the audit history.

cashier.name: Cashier
cashier.description: Daily-close drafts, sales, payments, expenses, cash counts and permitted draft exports.

storekeeper.name: Storekeeper
storekeeper.description: Receipts, stock counts, waste, hospitality and purchase-order proposals.

manager.name: Manager
manager.description: Closes the business day and approves adjustments when Abdo grants it.

comparison_editor.name: Comparison Editor
comparison_editor.description: Enters comparison figures for the assigned branch. Cannot view or export them.

attendance_kiosk.name: Attendance Kiosk
attendance_kiosk.description: Future: creates attendance events for its own branch only.

permission.daily_close_view: View daily close and cash counts

staff.title: Staff accounts
staff.intro: Create staff accounts, choose their branches and permission groups, and disable an account when someone leaves. Changes take effect on the person's next request, even if they are signed in.
staff.empty: There are no staff accounts yet.
staff.newIntro: This creates the sign-in account and the employee record together. Choose a temporary password and give it to the person privately; they choose their own at the first sign-in.
staff.temporaryPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. It is never stored by this application or shown again.
staff.accessIntro: A person can hold several groups. A group works only for the branch it is chosen under.
staff.disableHelp: A disabled person is signed out at once and cannot sign in. Their records and history are kept.
staff.passwordHelp: Sets a new temporary password. The person must choose their own at the next sign-in. Give it to them privately.

audit.title: Audit history
audit.intro: Administrative and operating changes are recorded here with who made them and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

action.catalog_names_queued: Names added to the review queue

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You do not have permission to open this page. If you need it, ask Abdo to add it to your access.

adjustments.title: Inventory adjustments
adjustments.intro: Record a stock adjustment for the branch. Products, units and quantities arrive in Phase 6; for now the reason is recorded and audited.
adjustments.invalid: Enter a valid date and a reason.

operations.roleRule: Record the branch manager who counted, the cashier, and the staff member who entered the count.
operations.countHome: Record denominations and reconcile cash at the time of counting.
operations.closeHome: Review business days, cash and purchasing custody in one place.
operations.zeroCountHint: Enter a quantity for each denomination counted. Enter an explicit 0 for an empty drawer.
operations.incomplete: Complete the cash figures to reconcile this count.

error.invalid: Check the required fields, amounts, times and day status, then try again.
error.conflict: This day changed while you were editing. Review the latest figures and try again.
error.duplicate: This deposit or request reference is already recorded.
error.denied: You no longer have permission to make this change.
error.unavailable: The day could not be saved. Try again.

operations.noDay: No saved day for this date.
operations.download: Download the day and its report basis (CSV)

catalog.title: Catalog and recipes
catalog.intro: Sold products, ingredients and packaging, their units, the Foodics names that map to them, and the recipe versions that turn a sale into consumption. Nothing here posts stock; that starts in Phase 6.

items.isAddOn: This is an add-on sold with another product
items.unitsHint: Every unit must convert to the base unit: the same kind of unit converts automatically, a carton or a sack needs an approved conversion below.
items.statusHint: A discontinued item stays in the catalog. Its recipes, its names and every past day keep resolving to it.
items.recipeLink: Open the recipes of this product

conversions.title: Unit conversions
conversions.intro: How many {unit} one of another unit holds, for this item only. Units of the same kind (kg and g) need none.
conversions.basis: Basis (who confirmed it, or the source)
conversions.locked: A conversion used by an approved recipe cannot change.

labels.title: Names in the sources
labels.empty: No source name is stored for this item.

review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Names, add-ons and units that cannot be used until a person decides them. Each entry names the exact source rows. Only the affected consumption stays blocked.
review.limit: Showing the first {n} entries. Use the filters to narrow the list.

unmapped_name.name: Unmapped Foodics name
unmapped_name.help: This name came from Foodics and no product is approved for it.

unconfirmed_mapping.name: Mapping to confirm
unconfirmed_mapping.help: The two source names may be the same product, but a person has not confirmed it.

ambiguous_addon.name: Ambiguous add-on
ambiguous_addon.help: The add-on is written differently on the sales row and in its recipe.

missing_unit.name: Missing unit
missing_unit.help: A recipe line has a quantity but no unit.

unit_conflict.name: Conflicting units
unit_conflict.help: The same ingredient is written in different units; recipes with these lines cannot be approved.

missing_quantity.name: Missing quantity
missing_quantity.help: A recipe line has no quantity (or a zero).

missing_component.name: Missing ingredient
missing_component.help: A recipe line has a quantity or unit but no ingredient.

untracked_component.name: Ingredient outside the inventory list
untracked_component.help: Recipes use this ingredient but the inventory list has no row for it.

empty_sales_row.name: Recipe on an empty sales row
empty_sales_row.help: The recipe reads a Product Mix row that has no name, so Foodics has nothing to match.

unlinked_recipe.name: Recipe without a sales row
unlinked_recipe.help: The recipe is not linked to any Product Mix row.

recipe_effective_date.name: Recipe start date
recipe_effective_date.help: Only Abdo can say when the November recipe set started.

review.dateHold: The November recipe versions stay drafts until this is answered.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.intro: One or more versions per sold product. A version is a draft until it is approved with its effective dates. Approved versions never change; a later version takes over from its start date.
recipes.noVersions: This product has no recipe yet.
recipes.yieldHint: Leave blank when the lines are per sold unit (the default).

approve.title: Approve this version
approve.to: Last day (leave blank for no end)
approve.hint: Approving fixes the recipe for these dates. An open earlier version ends the day before the first day.
approve.gatedNote: The dates must follow Abdo's confirmed start date. Until it is recorded in the review queue this version cannot be approved.
approve.endsBefore: Ends the day before the confirmed date: {date}

consumption.title: Consumption check
consumption.intro: Enter the sold lines of a business day to see which can be consumed through an approved mapping, a convertible unit and an approved recipe, and which are blocked and why. Nothing is saved or posted here.
consumption.linesHint: One per row: Foodics name | quantity
consumption.totals: Total consumption of the eligible lines
consumption.queue: Add the unmapped names to the review queue
consumption.unreadable: Row {rows} could not be read as «name | quantity». It is shown as blocked.
consumption.tooManyLines: Enter up to 500 lines and 20,000 characters per check.

reason.invalid_quantity: The quantity is not a positive number.
reason.unknown_product: This item is not a sold product.
reason.unmapped_name: No product is approved for this Foodics name. Add it to the review queue.
reason.mapping_pending: The mapping for this name is waiting for approval.
reason.mapping_rejected: This name was rejected and has no product.
reason.recipe_not_approved: The recipe of this product is still a draft.
reason.no_recipe_for_date: No approved recipe covers this business date.
reason.recipe_empty: The approved recipe has no lines.
reason.recipe_line_incomplete: Recipe line {line} has no ingredient or quantity.
reason.unit_incompatible: Recipe line {line}: {unit} does not convert to the base unit {base} of {component}.

warning.discontinued_before_date: This product was discontinued on {date}; the sale is still consumed.
